In the event of death of a Permanent Employee following benefits are extended to the nominee/family members of the deceased:
Nalco Employees Family Financial Assistance Rehabilitation Scheme (NEFFARS)
● Funeral Expenses, Death Gratuity, PF, Benevolent Fund, Group Insurance
● Group personal life Insurance.
● Group Insurance Scheme for HBA

● In the event of the death of a Permanent Worker, the nominee/family members receive the following benefits:
● Nalco Employees Family Financial Assistance Rehabilitation Scheme (NEFFARS)
● Funeral expenses, death gratuity, PF, benevolent fund, group insurance
● Group personal life insurance
● Group insurance scheme for HBA
In the event of the death of a non-permanent worker hired through contractors while on duty, the nominee/family members
receive the following benefits:
● A one-time lump-sum financial assistance
● Benefits under the ESIC Act 1948
● Benefits under the EPF & Misc Act 1942
